div.head: II Em 5
div.ab: Eac ic ðancige Gode ⁊ eow eallum, ðe me wel fylston, ⁊ þæs friðes, ðe we nu habbað æt ðam þyfðam; ðonne gelyfe ic to eow, þæt ge willan fylstan to ðissum swa miccle bet, swa us is eallum mare ðærf, ðæt hit gehealden sy.

Eac ic ðancie Gode ⁊ eow eallum, ðe me fylston, ðæs friðes, ðe we nu habbað æt ðam ðyfðam; ðonne gelyfe ic to eow, þæt ge willan fylstan to ðyssum swa micle bet, swa us is eallum mare ðearf, þæt hit gehealden sy.

Etiam gratias ago Deo et uobis omnibus, qui bene iuuatis me, de pace, quam pro furtis nuper instituimus; et ideo confido, quod adiuuare uelitis ad eam tanto melius, quanto magis opus est nobis, ut conseruata sit.

[Þæncunge ðæm ðe wið ðyfþe fylstaþ.] [Ld] Eac ic ðancie Gode ⁊ eow eallum, ðe me fylston, ðæs friðes ðe we nu habbað æt ðam ðyfðam; ðonne gelyfe ic to eow, þæt ge willan fylstan to ðyssum swa micle bet, swa us is eallum mare ðearf ðæt hit gehealden sy.

Further, I thank God and all of you, who have given me full support, for the immunity from thefts which we now enjoy. I therefore confidently expect of you, that you will be all the more willing to give your support towards this [maintenance of the public peace], in proportion as its observance is a more urgent matter for us all.

Further, I thank God and all of you who have well supported me, for the immunity from thefts which we now have; I now trust to you, that you will support this measure so much the better as the need is greater for all of us that it shall be observed.

(Dank denen, welche gegen Diebstahl helfen. Ld) Ferner dank ich Gott und euch allen, die ihr mir gut geholfen habt, für die Sicherheit vor Diebstählen, die wir bereits (festgesetzt lq) haben; ich vertraue nun auf euch, dass ihr zur vorliegenden [Rechtsordnung] um so viel besser helfen wollet, als uns allen nöthiger ist, dass dies beobachtet werde.

(Thanks to those who help against theft. Ld) Further I thank God and all of you who have helped me well for the security from thefts that we now have (have established, lq); I trust in you, then, that you will help with the present [legal order] all the better, the more needful it is for all of us that it be observed.
div.note: H's ‘⁊’ before ‘þæs friðes’ should be struck (so B and Quadr.).
